text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As promised, I contact Smart Falcon's
teachers, notifying them that she'll be
taking the day off. Together, we then
head to Oi
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, now I get it... but why today? It's
not like any big races are
going on, and
there aren't that many people either.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're trying to show me how great dirt
racing can be, right? If that's
the case, why
not take me to a more important race?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The competition is incredibly fierce
today.
Covered in dust from head
to toe, every
runner gives their all in the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They fight to eke out every last bit of
strength in their bodies. The
sight is the
furthest thing from pretty, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: C'mon! You can do it! Let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah! Oh no! Look out! She's gonna—ahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Captivated by the runners' passion to win,
the small audience erupts
into a
cacophony of roars. Eventually...

text_block_list.name: 1st Place Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Thank you all for cheering so hard for me! I really appreciate the support!

text_block_list.name: 1st Place Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pant... Phew... All right, let's finish the day with a smile! Next up, our winning concert! As for the song we'll be singing...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wow... That was amazing! Like, beyond
awesome even! And their
concert was
fantastic too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All the runners looked like they were
about to pass out... but they pushed
through and kept going! Even though they
got covered in dirt, they shone like stars
with the way they rushed across the track—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I think I get it now.
An Umadol shines
brightest when she's
doing her best and
running with everything she's got!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Their concert was all the more moving
because of how hard they worked to get
there.
They're exactly the kind of Umadol I
want to be someday!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I guess it doesn't matter if the course is
turf or dirt. You can inspire
your fans
either way! How could I have been so blind
to that?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I just assumed that I wouldn't be able to move my audience if I ran in dirt races, but I couldn't have been more wrong! Sigh... I'm honestly disappointed in myself...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, for the moment,
all I can say is... I'm
glad I was able to watch today's race. I
learned something important, and I also
had a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But I wouldn't have realized these things
without outside help... It's
still a fact that
people don't care as much about dirt
races, so these winning concerts probably
fly under the radar.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And because they don't feature top
runners, they'll stay unnoticed... It
feels
like such a shame.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh... I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
All I need to do is make dirt
racing a place for top racers
through my
running, singing, and dancing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it so more people want to run in
and watch dirt races! I'll
change the racing
world!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Isn't that super hard? Like,
harder
than just becoming a
world-class Umadol?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I guess I shouldn't give up just
'cause it's going to be a
challenge, right?
All that means is that I need to try
harder than ever!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But it doesn't matter how hard I try if
nobody knows who I am! So the
first step
toward my goal is to make myself known
to the world!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Keep it up?" I've gotta go above and
beyond or nothing will change!
Especially
in the marketing department! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shake my head. What she doesn't know is
that she's already making
good progress.
After all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember when I first laid eyes upon
her. Her lone figure sparkled
underneath the
evening sun as she danced and sang
before a backdrop of vibrant orange.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No one was watching. No one was
listening. And yet, she smiled wide
and
sang as if reaching out to an audience of
thousands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She filled me with hope and courage, and I
wouldn't trade her for
anyone else in the
world.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh wow...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay,
I've got it! I know what I want to do
about my next tryout race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few months go by, and the first batch of
tryouts since I started
training with Smart
Falcon rolls around.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna head out now! ☆ I'd
better hear you cheering me
on! ☆

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Who's the new face? She looks incredibly
excited... I don't think I've
ever seen her in
a dirt race before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's attention quickly shifts to
the
more high-profile runners.
But that's
exactly what we need for her to stand out.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew... Hiyaaaa! ☆☆☆

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Wha... Whoa, she's fast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon kicks up a storm of dust,
widening the gap between her
and the
other runners at an incredible speed. All
eyes lock onto her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's so easy to run on dirt! But I
knew that! I've always known
that! This...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is my stage! This is where I shine
brightest! And I'm finally ready
to
sparkle! ☆☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon runs as freely as a bird
soaring through the sky. The dirt
course is
hers for the taking, and no one else even
comes close.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I did it! I won! ☆☆

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! Can I talk to you for a minute! Who
even are you?! And where have you been
all this time?! Are you looking for a
trainer? If you
are...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Awww, am I famous already? ☆ Sorry, but
I'll have to get back to you
on that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are! I was looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! ☆ Hey, how was I? Did I light up
the track?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm glad. Anyway, let's talk.
There's something I've been
meaning to
ask you, so listen carefully, okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Will you be my trainer and help me
become the best Umadol I can
be?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Thanks so much! ☆☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled... Hello, my
fans—both old and new! I'd like to

introduce myself one more time! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What do you do when Falco runs?! (Chase
her! Chase her!) Catch me with hearts full
of love! ☆ I'm Smart Falcon, and I'm the
cutest Umadol
around! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to become dirt racing's top
Umadol! And in order to
make my dream
come true, I need your support! So
please...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Show me your love and catch me if you
can! ☆ Ehehe! ♪
